description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for managing pseudo-merge groups, including configuration loading, commit indexing, and bitmap operations related to pseudo-merges in a version control system.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_group
classes.description: Represents a group of pseudo-merges with associated pattern and parameters.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_matches
classes.description: Holds stable and unstable commit arrays for a pseudo-merge match set.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_map
classes.description: Serialized view of a file containing pseudo-merge data.

classes.name: pseudo_merge
classes.description: Represents an individual pseudo-merge with commit and bitmap data.

methods.name: pseudo_merge_group_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a pseudo_merge_group.
